subject: Unmatched credit on ledger: allocation proof and VAT split request
messages:
From: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@blueharbor.co.uk>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@blueharbor.co.uk
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Payment posted but unapplied — invoices BH-INV-2143 / BH-INV-2139

Mateo,

We posted a BACS payment from our treasury team yesterday (09-Nov) referencing your customer ref 987654. Our bank shows two line items totaling GBP 42,750.00 but your ledger has applied only GBP 39,500.00 and the remainder is sitting as an unidentified credit on your statement.

Attached is our remittance advice (remittance_20261109.pdf) and a short CSV extract from our bank showing the two transaction lines. Can you confirm how you want us to proceed? If we need to reissue a remittance with VAT split per invoice line, we can do that but would prefer confirmation of the target allocation first.

Invoices:
 - BH-INV-2143 (GBP 26,500.00 incl VAT)
 - BH-INV-2139 (GBP 16,250.00 incl VAT)

We ran the remittance from our lockbox. Payment reference used: RBH987654.

Thanks,

Tariq Hassan
Head of Treasury
BlueHarbor Ltd
attachments: remittance_20261109.pdf (pdf), bank_statement_20261109_excerpt.csv (csv)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@blueharbor.co.uk>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment posted but unapplied — invoices BH-INV-2143 / BH-INV-2139

Tariq — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV extract.

Quick update from my side: I’ve looped in our AP lead (Laura) and the ledger owner (Irene) so we can reconcile. Two quick asks so we can close the unidentified credit today:

1) Can you confirm the net / VAT breakdown on the remittance for each invoice line (we show a mismatch vs the invoice VAT lines). If you can send a remittance with explicit VAT per invoice line that will speed allocation.
2) If possible, attach the full bank trace (MT103 or full lockbox report) rather than the CSV excerpt — it helps our bank reconciliation team match the incoming trace id.

If Laura confirms we can allocate one of the lines as a partial apply and move the smaller amount to a credit memo, we’ll issue a ledger footnote for audit purposes and mark the account as cleared.

Irene / Laura — can you confirm whether the ledger currently has a currency conversion discrepancy? The bank extract Tariq sent looks like the smaller item may have been posted in GBP while the invoice was recorded in EUR on our side.

I’ll hold off on applying until we have the bank trace or a corrected remittance to avoid mis-allocating VAT.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Accounts Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
phone: +44 20 7946 3120

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@blueharbor.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment posted but unapplied — invoices BH-INV-2143 / BH-INV-2139

Thanks — I pulled the cash application queue this morning. Findings:

- There are two incoming payments: GBP 26,500.00 and GBP 16,250.00 (matches Tariq’s CSV).
- Our ledger shows BH-INV-2143 recorded as EUR 30,000.00 (converted at our system rate) and BH-INV-2139 recorded as GBP 16,250.00. The system auto-applied the GBP 16,250.00 to BH-INV-2139.
- The GBP 26,500 posted to an open EUR invoice (BH-INV-2143) but due to a currency mismatch our auto-match rules left GBP 26,500 as an unapplied credit. We need either a remittance that specifies the original EUR amounts or a bank trace showing the originating currency to force a currency reclassify on the posting.

Suggested next steps (proposed by finance):
1) BlueHarbor reissue remittance with invoice-level VAT and original invoice currency column OR provide MT103/lockbox trace.
2) Once we receive the trace/remit we will: a) convert the GBP unapplied line to EUR using the bank’s value date rate and b) apply to BH-INV-2143 and create a ledger footnote referencing this trace for audit.
3) We can prepare a short credit memo for any rounding delta if present and circulate a clearing note for your records.

Tariq — if you can confirm you can send MT103 or a corrected remittance by tomorrow EOB we’ll complete allocation the same day.

Laura Bennett
AP Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@blueharbor.co.uk>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment posted but unapplied — invoices BH-INV-2143 / BH-INV-2139

Laura / Mateo — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached are the full lockbox trace (bank_statement_20261109_excerpt.csv) and a draft of a corrected remittance that includes invoice-level VAT and the original EUR invoiced amounts (proposed_corrected_remit_draft.pdf). The MT103 reference is 20261109GBRMT103-7782.

We expect treasury to confirm the EUR/GBP conversion reference by end of day; if there is any rounding delta we’ll post a one-off adjustment and notify you. Please confirm when you apply so we can close the payment on our side and remove the unapplied item.

Action requested: Laura — please send me the ledger footnote text you’ll post (just a one-paragraph audit note) and confirm the credit memo workflow if there’s a <GBP 5 difference.

Thanks,
Tariq
attachments: bank_statement_20261109_excerpt.csv (csv), proposed_corrected_remit_draft.pdf (pdf)
